classification.difficultyReason: Plot and name the reflected points on shared axes, carry the intermediate coordinates into the next reflection, and recognise that reversing the order gives the same endpoint.

content.prompt: The point $P(a,b)$ is shown in the diagram below.

spec.sourceRegion: Printed page 245, Question 1, beneath the stem
spec.description: Unscaled, unticked Cartesian axes with positive arrows and a blue given point above and to the right of the origin. All four quadrants remain available for plotting.
spec.mathematics: The position of P(a,b) is schematic. Its horizontal distance from the y-axis is less than its vertical distance from the x-axis.
spec.answerVisibility: The axes and P are visible. The reflected points are answer-only.

children.label: a
children.prompt: The point $P$ is reflected across the $x$-axis. Label the result $Q$, and write down the coordinates.

answer.worked: Reflection across the $x$-axis keeps the $x$-coordinate and changes the sign of the $y$-coordinate. Plot $Q(a,-b)$ directly below $P$ at the same distance from the $x$-axis.

children.label: b
children.prompt: The point $P$ is reflected across the $y$-axis. Label the result $R$, and write down the coordinates.

answer.worked: Reflection across the $y$-axis keeps the $y$-coordinate and changes the sign of the $x$-coordinate. Plot $R(-a,b)$ directly left of $P$ at the same distance from the $y$-axis.

children.label: c
children.prompt: The point $R$ is reflected across the $x$-axis. Label the result $S$, and write down the coordinates.

answer.worked: Keep the $x$-coordinate of $R(-a,b)$ and change $b$ to $-b$. Plot $S(-a,-b)$ directly below $R$ at the same distance from the $x$-axis.

children.label: d
children.prompt: The point $Q$ is reflected across the $y$-axis. What do you notice?

answer.short: It lands at the same point $S(-a,-b)$.
answer.worked: Reflecting $Q(a,-b)$ across the $y$-axis changes $a$ to $-a$, giving $S(-a,-b)$ as in part (c). Each reflection changes the sign of a different coordinate, so either order gives the same point.

spec.sourceRegion: Printed page 245, Question 1, shared axes and parts (a)–(d)
spec.description: Completed version of the supplied axes, with all reflected points plotted and labelled.
spec.mathematics: Q is directly below P, R is directly left of P, and S is directly below R and left of Q.
